commitMessage: Publish the package as an ES module

expect.logRegex: require is not defined in ES module scope

decoys.note: Converts to ESM but reads defaults.json relative to the working directory.

notes: The commit added "type": "module" and an ESM index, but config.js still requires modules and uses __dirname, and merge.js still assigns module.exports. The fix converts both (import.meta.dirname for defaults.json); renaming them to .cjs with a CJS-aware index also passes.
